claim.text: The struck vehicle became a hazard by closing within the ego lane, with hazard onset at 6.1333 s.
Perception took 0.2351 s, below the 0.3 s threshold.
Command took 0.0467 s, below the 0.1 s threshold.
Brake actuation took 1.48 s, above the 0.45 s threshold.
Brake pressure was reached only 0.0983 s before impact.
With nominal perception 0.2 s, nominal command 0.05 s and nominal brake tau 0.35 s, the counterfactual replay avoided contact.
The counterfactual replay left a minimum gap of 1.5765 m.
Both witness observations reported a dry road surface.
